'''Gastón Sebastián Ada''' (born 18 November 1988) is an Argentine professional [[Association football|footballer]] who plays as a [[midfielder]] or [[Forward (association football)|forward]] for [[Club Atlético Los Andes|Los Andes]].<ref name="Soccerway">{{cite news|title=Argentina - G. Ada|url=https://int.soccerway.com/players/gaston-ada/129991/|accessdate=30 December 2018|work=Soccerway}}</ref>

==Career==
Ada began in the youth system of [[Boca Juniors]], prior to having senior stints with fellow [[Argentine Primera División]] outfit [[Argentinos Juniors]] and Brazilian side [[Figueirense FC|Figueirense]]; though no league appearances followed.<ref name="Soccerway"/><ref name="ESPN">{{cite news|title=Figueirense contrata argentinos para a próxima temporada|url=https://www.espn.com.br/noticia/94570_figueirense-contrata-argentinos-para-a-proxima-temporada|accessdate=30 December 2018|work=ESPN|date=29 December 2009}}</ref><ref name="BDFA">{{cite news|title=Ficha Estadistica de GASTON ADA|url=https://www.bdfa.com.ar/jugadores-GASTON-SEBASTIAN-ADA-84906.html|accessdate=30 December 2018|work=BDFA}}</ref> In 2011, Ada joined [[Deportivo Morón]] of [[Primera B Metropolitana]].<ref name="Soccerway"/> He netted the first goals of his career during the [[2011–12 Primera B Metropolitana]] campaign, namely against [[Club Atlético General Lamadrid|General Lamadrid]], [[CSD Flandria|Flandria]] and [[Club Atlético Nueva Chicago|Nueva Chicago]].<ref name="Soccerway"/> Ada played just once in the following season, which preceded the player leaving for fellow [[Argentine football league system|third tier]] club [[Deportivo Merlo]].<ref name="Soccerway"/> He made the first of thirty-one appearances on 6 August 2013 versus [[Club Atlético Temperley|Temperley]].<ref name="Soccerway"/>

Ada signed for [[Club Atlético Acassuso|Acassuso]] in July 2014.<ref name="Soccerway" /><ref name="Acassuso">{{cite news|title=Ada Gastón|url=http://www.clubacassuso.com.ar/nuevo/acassuso/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=1314:ada-gaston&catid=35:torneo-actual&Itemid=76|accessdate=30 December 2018|work=Acassuso}}</ref> He scored two goals in forty‑six fixtures across two seasons with the club.<ref name="Soccerway" /> He spent the next two campaigns with [[Primera B Nacional]]'s [[Juventud Unida de Gualeguaychú|Juventud Unida]].<ref name="Soccerway"/> Seven goals were scored in that period, one of which came in a match with [[Club Sportivo Estudiantes|Estudiantes]] - a team that then signed Ada on 10 August 2017.<ref name="Soccerway"/> Ten months after, on 9 June 2018, Ada completed a move to [[Ferro Carril Oeste]].<ref name="Olé">{{cite news|title=Un Ada en el Ferrocarril|url=https://www.pressreader.com/argentina/ol%C3%A9/20180609/282166471880864|accessdate=30 December 2018|work=Olé|date=9 June 2018}}</ref> After eight appearances in [[2018–19 Primera B Nacional|2018–19]], Ada terminated his contract on 2 August 2019 in order to join [[Deportes Valdivia]] of [[Primera B de Chile]] on 4 August.<ref name="FCO1">{{cite news|title=El delantero Gastón Ada rescindió su contrato con Ferro de común acuerdo con la Institución|url=https://twitter.com/FerroOficial/status/1157323968988295169|accessdate=11 August 2019|work=Ferro Carril Oeste|date=2 August 2019}}</ref><ref name="PB1">{{cite news|title=Deportes Valdivia ya tiene a su tercer refuerzo|url=https://www.primerabchile.cl/noticias-destacadas/deportes-valdivia-ya-tiene-a-su-tercer-refuerzo/|accessdate=11 August 2019|work=Primera B|date=4 August 2019}}</ref>
